question: Where was the world's largest solar tree installed in India in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Durgapur.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **CSIR's Central Mechanical Engineering Research **Institute have developed world's largest 'solar tree'.
 
• It is installed at its residential complex in **Durgapur in West Bengal.**

 
• It is to promote the usage of Solar energy.
 
• The solar tree has been designed in a manner to **ensure maximum exposure of each solar photovoltaic (PV) panel to sunlight **and also the creation of the least amount of shadow area beneath.
 
• The installed capacity of the Solar Tre is above 11.5 kWp.
 
• It has the annual capacity to generate 12,000-14,000 units of Clean and Green Power.
 
• There are a total of** 35 Solar PV Panels** in each tree with a capacity of **330 wp (watts peak) each.**
